description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Text, which is a specialized subclass of Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice used for identifying and handling text-based browser user agents within the Zend Framework's HTTP component. It includes features such as matching user agent strings against known signatures, and methods for determining device capabilities like markup support.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Text
classes.description: A class for matching and representing text-based user agents, extending Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if the user agent string matches any known signatures for text browsers.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'text', indicating the type of user agent.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Defines device features such as images, frames, javascript support, etc.

methods.name: getImageFormatSupport
methods.description: Returns null, as image format support is not specified.

methods.name: getPreferredMarkup
methods.description: Returns 'xhtml' as the preferred markup format.

methods.name: getXhtmlSupportLevel
methods.description: Returns integer 1, indicating support level for XHTML.

methods.name: hasFlashSupport
methods.description: Indicates whether the device supports Flash (returns false).

methods.name: hasPdfSupport
methods.description: Indicates whether the device supports PDF (returns false).
